# FTEP third-party component registry

This registry records runtime and integration dependencies that affect FTEP
distribution. `UNKNOWN` license data or a `BLOCKED_PENDING_REVIEW`
redistribution mode is a release blocker, not a value to fill with a guess.

The seed covers the currently integrated Shipwright native pathway and its
in-tree/submodule build dependencies. Ecosystem-wide Cargo, npm, CMake, and
system-library acknowledgement generation remains a later release-engineering
task.
